propositions.canonicalProposition: From 2022 the candidate was the named owner of the event-tracking pipeline, with approval rights over every schema change to the event tables.
propositions.rationale: The written reference from the former vice president of data confirms the ownership and the approval rights.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate agreed data contracts with three producer teams setting out event names, required fields and a change-notice period.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the contracts and the work sample shows the signed billing contract.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built and maintained dbt models for the event tables, with tests running on every pull request.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the models and the tests.

expectedGap: The candidate reported warehouse spend and proposed changes that the head of data approved; holding the budget is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified pipeline ownership and schema-approval rights; describe the cost work as reporting and proposals approved by the head of data.
